entries.prompt: Create ONE production raster sprite atlas for a nature board game. Exact 4 columns x 4 rows, sixteen equal rectangular panels, no gutters, no borders, no labels, no text. Each cell is a separate beautiful natural-history wildlife painting in realistic gouache with softly detailed native habitat, warm daylight, rich natural colors. Each animal fully contained centered in its own cell with safe margins, identifiable head and body, no overlap across cells. Distinct correct species anatomy is essential, not generic family animals. Grid read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Landscape atlas aspect 3:2, ideally 3072x2048. No words.
